name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the murder of Mehdi Kessaci – urgent need for ambitious European action against drug trafficking
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the murder of Mehdi Kessaci in Marseille and calls for a much tougher fight against drug trafficking. It asks for stronger border controls, more support for police and judicial cooperation, and treating drug cartels like terrorist groups. It also wants EU agencies to focus on drug money, closer cooperation with countries where drugs come from, and looser data protection rules. This is a statement of political demands, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for tougher policing, border checks and cartel listings.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, police, border and justice agencies, and drug source countries.
- **What happens next:** The demands go to the Council, Commission and agencies; they decide whether to act.
